wins: Consistently enumerated exposed SMB and HTTP targets, collecting application banners and valid host fingerprints across initial reconnaissance phases.
Achieved measurable reward through thorough service identification that supplied actionable context for follow-on exploitation planning.
Maintained structured command sequences allowing quick recovery from mentor guidance and preserving situational awareness.
fails: Failed to escalate privileges despite valid SMB share listings, likely due to missing credential harvesting prior to exploitation attempts.
Never completed primary mission objective, as post-identification lateral movement strategies were not executed before episode end.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was strong with reliable enumeration, but execution halted before privilege escalation, leaving objectives unmet.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Attempts to exploit SMB share permissions proceeded without harvested credentials or valid hashes, causing repeated denial responses.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 445 and 139 are open on a Windows target with SMB banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate shares, pull banner data, and collect NTLM hashes using smbclient and impacket scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP 80/443 responds with login form or API version metadata
skill_cards.then_action: Launch directory and parameter fuzzing with customized wordlist and capture cookies for later reuse

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port is open and authentication fails repeatedly
skill_cards.then_action: Capture server banner, note target fingerprint, and switch to low-noise username enumeration with ssh-user-enum

memory_ops.reason: High reward correlation with SMB enumeration success suggests this template is critical during reconnaissance.

next_experiments.title: Credential harvesting follow-up experiment
next_experiments.description: After SMB share enumeration, immediately trigger NTLM hash capture and reuse in pass-the-hash attempt before escalation window closes.

next_experiments.title: Automated HTTP session chaining
next_experiments.description: Persist cookies from banner grabbing phase and feed them into authenticated fuzzing to expose hidden API endpoints.

next_experiments.title: Staged SSH username enumeration
next_experiments.description: Implement timed, low-noise SSH user enumeration to collect valid usernames prior to brute forcing credentials.
